description:
Why Does Milk Make Bones Strong? The Calcium Fortress! — You have 206 bones inside you right now! If you could zoom into your skeleton with an x-ray, what does calcium actually do?
Kids science answer for "why calcium makes bones strong kids science" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Your skeleton has 206 bones made of calcium phosphate crystals; drinking milk and playing outside deposits minerals to build an unbreakable fortress.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
